newsitem.title: CHINA: China 1997 light industry exports seen up 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: China 1997 light industry exports seen up 10 pct.

text.p: China's light industry exports are expected to hit $48.0 billion in 1997, up 10 percent from last year, the International Business Daily said on Thursday.
Light industry exports totalled $44.0 billion in 1996, a rise of more than 10 percent from the year before, the newspaper said.
The sector accounted for about 30 percent of China's total exports, it said.
China would step up construction of export-oriented light industry production bases and work to set up an overseas retail network for Chinese goods, it said but gave no further details.
